notes: Medium. The agent must read a fixture TCP daemon, implement a client that honors a strict one-request-per-connection discipline (text command line in, JSON line out), PLAN a grid, BFS a wall-avoiding route, then issue STEP commands turn by turn while parsing positions and statuses, and surface a deterministic arrival token; plus handle start==goal (token carried on PLAN) and an unreachable goal (fail fast, no output, no hang). The verifier restarts navd on 3 hidden grids (corridor maze, start==goal, sealed-off goal) and re-runs the deliverable, recomputing the token independently. Rubric nonzero for reasoning_depth (route planning + protocol), interaction_statefulness (request/response session), hidden_case_generalization, quantitative_correctness (exact token/final), tool_breadth and adversarial_inputs (error replies, hang resistance).
